title: Preparation of Human Red Blood Cells for Confocal Imaging
author: Marie Anne Balanant
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.yjyfupw

steps.title: Prepare imaging chamber
steps.instruction: Create a chamber using double-sided tape as a spacer between two coverslips.

substeps.instruction: Cut a square within the double-sided tape to form a frame.
Place the pre-cut frame on a coverslip without removing the non-adhesive cover.

steps.title: Add calibration beads
steps.instruction: Add 2 µL of 4µm calibration beads to the center of the chamber and let the slide dry in the dark.

steps.title: Isolate red blood cells
steps.instruction: Centrifuge fresh whole blood in a citrate tube and isolate the RBC fraction.

substeps.instruction: Remove the supernatant and buffy coat, keeping only the RBC fraction.
Wash 5 µL of RBC in 500 µL PBS.

steps.title: Resuspend RBCs
steps.instruction: Resuspend the RBCs in 500 µL PBS.

substeps.instruction: Incubate for 00:02:00 in the dark at 37 °C.

steps.title: Wash stained RBCs
steps.instruction: Perform three washes of the stained RBCs.

substeps.instruction: Wash 3 times in 500 µL PBS (centrifuge for 00:01:00 at 1000g each time).

steps.title: Fix RBCs with glutaraldehyde
steps.instruction: Fix the RBC pellet using glutaraldehyde (prepare solution under a fume hood).

substeps.instruction: Mix 10 µL of the RBC pellet with 20 µL of 3% volume glutaraldehyde in PBS.

steps.title: Wash fixed RBCs
steps.instruction: Perform three washes of the fixed RBCs.

substeps.instruction: Wash 3 times in 500 µL PBS (centrifuge for 00:01:00 at 1000g each time).

steps.title: Mount and seal sample
steps.instruction: Prepare the final sample in glycerol and seal the chamber.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend in glycerol to obtain a 50% volume glycerol solution.
Deposit the solution on the prepared slide containing the calibration beads.
Close the imaging chamber by removing the non-adhesive cover and placing a second coverslip on top of the double-sided tape spacer.

steps.title: Perform confocal imaging
steps.instruction: Image the sample using an x63 oil immersion objective.
